_invalid_because: commitment.designated_roles is typed array (RFC-MACP-0010 §6). A bare string is the natural single-role shorthand a policy author would reach for, and JSON Schema will not coerce it. Isolates the type keyword -- deliberately NOT paired with authority 'designated_role', so that the conditional arm added by issue #116 never fires and `type` remains the sole cause of rejection. Pairing them would make this fixture and designated-role-without-roles.json overlap and break the diagonal.
